messages:
sam: FYI starting the late-window deploy at 23:00 UTC for the header swap. This touches router, API, runtime and Console toggles. Need quick sync on pins and rollback lanes.
angela: copy. what's the pin strategy for API? back-compat opt-in header?
sam: API will ship v2.3.1 with opt-in header 'x-rw-mode: new'. We'll route 10% initially. runtime needs kv-eviction flag toggled to avoid hot-kv blowups.
juan: runtime flag is `--kv-evict=adaptive-v2`. Can we gate it behind model variant so legacy traffic unaffected?
maria: Console will flip the header toggle via feature-flag at the same time. I can delay UI toggle until we confirm route 100%.
angela: ok. deploybot, can you pin router and API variants to compatible hashes?
dev-deploy-bot: @channel wave plan prepared. Routers: router@sha:abc123 -> new-header-enabled variant. API: api@sha:def456 -> v2.3.1. Runtime: runtime@sha:ghi789 -> kv-evict-adaptive. Console: console@sha:jkl012 -> ff-toggle-stage.
sam: perfect. Rollback plan? If API errors spike we'll revert router routing first, then API. Runtime kv change is riskier — prefer to unpin runtime last.
juan: runtime rollback is ~3min to restart pools. Need to make sure canary nodes drained first. Add `graceful-drain=60s`.
maria: console rollback is one-click; I'll hold off flipping the feature until we see stable traces.
angela: telemetry checks? What SLOs should trigger rollback?
sam: define thresholds: 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained 2m OR p95 latency +40% baseline. Also memory > 75% host for runtime for 3m.
opsbot: Alert rule updated: "late-window-header-swap" with those thresholds. Pager group: infra-oncall.
dev-deploy-bot: Starting canary wave 1 in eu-west-1 at T+5m. Canary cardinality: 8 routers, 4 api pods, 2 runtime nodes.
juan: watching runtime logs. preflight: kv hit-rate and eviction counts ok.
maria: console ready to flip on canary confirmation.
angela: confirm feature flag is set to 'canary' not 'on' so only routed traffic sees it.
sam: yep. remember to annotate release notes: breaking header opt-in but backward compatible by default.
juan: if we see unexpected key eviction, I'll pin runtime back to previous SHA and scale-up fallback nodes.
dev-deploy-bot: Canary wave 1 success. No 5xx, p95 +8%. Proceeding to wave 2 (gradual ramp to 30%).
maria: holding console toggle until wave 3.
angela: I'll draft the rollback runbook quick note in the release channel.
sam: thanks team. if wave 2 looks clean, we do final ramp and then console toggle. keep comms tight. :thumbsup:
